articles.title: A Toronto woman discovered a wild coyote pup sleeping in her bedroom; the animal had quietly entered through an open door and settled into her bed while she waited for her cleaner
articles.summary: A Toronto homeowner received an unexpected visitor when a young wild coyote quietly entered her house through an open door and made itself comfortable on
articles.body: A Toronto homeowner received an unexpected visitor when a young wild coyote quietly entered her house through an open door and made itself comfortable on her bedroom bed. The incident happened while Alice Kent was waiting for her regular cleaner, who spotted the animal upstairs and initially mistook it for a fox. What began as an ordinary day quickly turned into an unusual wildlife encounter, bringing police and animal rescue workers to the Christie Pits neighbourhood and raising questions about how wild coyotes behave around people.Toronto woman discover a coyote pup in her bedroomThe incident took place at Kent's home in the Christie Pits neighbourhood of Toronto. On the day of the encounter, she had left the doors open while waiting for her cleaner to arrive. The animal apparently took advantage of the opportunity, walked into the house and made its way upstairs without attracting attention.According to CBC News, the cleaner was the first to notice something unusual when she went upstairs to begin her work. She returned partway down the stairs and calmly alerted Kent that she thought there was a fox in the bedroom.Kent initially struggled to believe the warning. She thought the cleaner might have been playing a joke or that there was a stuffed animal in the room. However, when she went upstairs to investigate, she found a young coyote lying on her bed.The unexpected visitor had already been seen around the propertyThe coyote was not entirely unfamiliar with the surroundings. Kent had noticed coyotes around her property in the days leading up to the incident.In her account of the encounter, covered by Toronto Life, the homeowner described how young coyotes had previously been spotted around the house. The family had also seen them using the outdoor space as a resting place.Kent had noticed 3 young coyotes around her back deck shortly before the bedroom incident. Their presence suggested that a coyote family was living in the neighbourhood, making occasional visits to residential properties.Why was the coyote's presence a concernAlthough the young animal's choice of resting place might have seemed amusing at first, the situation carried genuine concerns for the household.According to CBC News, Kent became worried about the safety of her children, the cleaner and other members of the family. A wild animal that feels trapped or threatened could react unpredictably, particularly if it cannot find a way out.The animal also appeared to be in poor health. It was suffering from mange, a skin condition caused by microscopic mites that can lead to irritation, scabs and patches of missing fur.CTV News highlighted this unpleasant side of the unexpected visit. The coyote had left the bedroom in a condition that made the experience considerably less amusing for the homeowners.The animal's health was also important for the wildlife team assessing the situation. According to the Toronto Wildlife Centre's executive director, Nathalie Karvonen, mange can leave coyotes weak, underweight and less capable of finding food. Animals in this condition may take greater risks than they normally would.Wildlife rescuers helped remove the animal from the houseOnce Kent realised that the visitor was a wild coyote, she contacted the authorities for assistance. Police were also called, and the Toronto Wildlife Centre became involved in removing the animal safely.The rescue was important because the pup was already familiar to the wildlife organisation. Karvonen explained that the centre had been trying to locate and treat a family of coyotes in the area because several members were affected by mange.The response team eventually located the young animal hiding underneath the bed. Rather than allowing the situation to escalate, the rescuers carefully captured it and carried out an initial assessment.The pup received treatment for mange at the location before being released back into the area. The intervention meant that the animal could receive attention for its health condition without the encounter ending in unnecessary harm.How can residents avoid attracting coyotesKarvonen raised concerns about residents feeding coyotes in the neighbourhood. According to her, regularly providing food can change the way wild animals respond to people and their surroundings.Coyotes that become accustomed to receiving food from humans may gradually lose their natural caution. This can make them more comfortable approaching houses and entering spaces that they would ordinarily avoid.The Toronto Wildlife Centre has encouraged residents not to feed wild coyotes or make them comfortable around people. Removing potential food sources and avoiding direct interaction can help maintain a safer distance between wildlife and households.You use AI every day. Now get your AI Quotient. Take the AIQ test.

articles.title: Delhi-Bihar bus services on 18 routes after inter-state pact
articles.summary: Delhi and Bihar sign pact to start regular bus services on 18 routes, issuing 216 permits to connect Delhi with 13 Bihar destinations via major UP hubs.
articles.body: New Delhi: Delhi and Bihar signed a transport agreement Friday to launch regular buses across 18 routes. Chief minister Rekha Gupta noted that this year-round service will ease hometown travel for nearly 20 lakh residents from Bihar and Purvanchal living in the capital.Under the agreement, Delhi’s transport department has issued 216 permits to Bihar for operating buses on the identified routes. The chief minister flagged off the interstate bus service from Maharana Pratap ISBT at Kashmere Gate. Bihar transport minister Damodar Rawat and Delhi transport minister Pankaj Kumar Singh were also present.The services will connect Delhi to 13 cities and regions in Bihar — including Patna, Gaya, Darbhanga, Madhubani, Bhagalpur, Muzaffarpur, Buxar and Purnia — while also covering major hubs in Uttar Pradesh. Key cities like Patna, Gaya and Muzaffarpur will be served by multiple routes.Gupta said the initiative reflected the growing cooperation between the two states. She said the improved connectivity would also benefit students and workers who frequently travel between the two states.Transport minister Pankaj Kumar Singh said the facility would provide relief to passengers who face difficulties getting tickets during festivals such as Chhath, Diwali and Dussehra. The number of buses would be increased according to passenger demand, he added.The deal builds on successful festive special bus operations, which saw 210 corporation and PPP buses run in 2025, followed by 155 buses connecting Bihar with Delhi and other states during Diwali and Chhath this year.To expand services, Bihar State Road Transport Corporation has procured 75 non-AC and 74 AC buses. It also plans to deploy 150 buses through the PPP model. The agreement allocates 12 permits each to Delhi and Bihar on every route, paving the way for organised and regular interstate services.Passing through major Uttar Pradesh transit hubs — including Gorakhpur, Lucknow, Varanasi, Prayagraj, Kanpur, Agra and Noida —the routes will link Delhi to 13 Bihar destinations: Araria, Bihar Sharif, Bhagalpur, Buxar, Darbhanga, East Champaran, Gaya, Kishanganj, Madhubani, Muzaffarpur, Nawada, Patna and Purnia.You Can Also Check: Gold Rate in Delhi | Silver Rate in Delhi | Bank Holidays in Delhi | Public Holidays in Delhi | Delhi AQI | Weather in Delhi | Petrol Price in Delhi | Diesel Price in Delhi | CNG Price in Delhi | LPG Price in DelhiStay updated with the latest Delhi news. articles.body: A U.S. military aircraft disabled a commercial vessel in the Gulf of Oman on Thursday after it tried to evade the naval blockade of all Iranian ports, which has been in effect since mid-July. The Palau-flagged M/V Pacific Archer left Bandar Abbas, a major port city on Iran's southern coast, before the U.S. Central Command (CENTCOM) fired precision munitions at the ship's stern, destroying its propulsion. A video released by the military shows a projectile hitting the back of the ship and causing an explosion. The civilian crew was unharmed in the strike, CENTCOM said. So far, U.S. forces have redirected 158 compliant commercial vessels and disabled six that refused to comply. articles.title: Nebraska Sen. Deb Fischer’s husband died by suicide, spokesperson says
articles.summary: The longtime husband of Sen.
articles.body: The longtime husband of Sen. Deb Fischer, R-Neb., died by suicide, her office announced on Friday, after initially saying that he “passed away peacefully” nearly a week ago. Fischer first released a statement on X on Sunday announcing that her husband of more than 50 years, Bruce Fischer, died the day prior to the post “doing what he loved the most, spending time outdoors.” Fischer, a Republican who has served in the Senate since 2012, wrote in the first statement that she would “cherish the decades we spent building a family in the Nebraska Sandhills.” “Above all, Bruce was a loving husband, a devoted father and grandfather, a man of faith and a rancher,” the official wrote on Nov. 23. On Friday morning, a spokesperson for the senator released a statement on a “sad update in the death” of Bruce Fischer. “Initially, it was believed that Bruce passed peacefully at home,” the statement on X read. “Upon further investigation, it was learned that Bruce chose to end his life.” The spokesperson did not disclose details about the suicide or how the determination was made. Fischer has been in office since 2012 and is currently serving her third term. She and her husband were cattle ranchers and continued to run a ranching business, according to her official biography. articles.title: Mizkif questions Kai Cenat's gaming passion after streamer launches separate YouTube channel
articles.summary: Kai Cenat has opened a new chapter in his streaming career by launching a separate YouTube gaming channel.
articles.body: Kai Cenat has opened a new chapter in his streaming career by launching a separate YouTube gaming channel. The streamer introduced @KaiCenatGaming on November 25, 2026, with a video explaining what viewers can expect from the channel. He plans to upload offline gameplay, horror games and other gaming content while giving himself more time to enjoy games away from livestreams. However, fellow streamer Mizkif is not convinced by the move. He questioned Kai's interest in gaming and called the new channel "forced" and "fake."Kai Cenat explains why he launched a separate YouTube gaming channelIn his first video, titled Welcome To My Gaming Channel..., Kai Cenat spoke about his plans and asked viewers to suggest games they would like to see. The channel had already crossed 100,000 subscribers at the time of Sportskeeda's report.Kai made it clear that he has several ideas ready but does not want to reveal everything just yet. He also stressed that staying consistent with uploads will be important.He said:"Welcome to my gaming channel where we'll be doing a whole bunch of offline gaming, horror games, fun games, every type of game. All right. Um, I got a lot of fun stuff lined up for us, and I cannot wait, but I got to keep everything a secret, and I got to make sure that we stay consistent."The streamer also explained why he wanted a separate space for gaming. According to him, there are times when he simply wants to play a game and explore it without making the entire experience a livestream.He added:"Please do me a favor and comment what games y'all would like to see. I really hope I'm very consistent on this channel, but I'm also excited because there will be some times where I just want to game and just dive deeper into that. So, this is what this channel is for. So, hopefully you guys are ready, and I can't wait to see you guys soon. Later. Goodbye."His recent gaming activity also gives some background to this decision. According to Sportskeeda, around 31% of Kai's career streaming time on Twitch has involved video games. His recent GTA and Minecraft sessions have also been a major part of his gaming content.Earlier in November, Kai completed five GTA games in just over 130 hours. He played GTA III, Vice City, San Andreas, GTA IV and GTA V before moving on to GTA VI.
